rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for the color green.

example.jyutping: ngo5 zeoi3 zung1 ji3 luk6 sik1

rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice when green refers to color, especially before a noun such as 綠色嘅衫.

example.english: This green shirt really suits you.
example.traditional: 呢件綠色嘅衫幾啱你喎。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 luk6 sik1 ge3 saam1 gei2 ngaam1 nei5 wo3

rows.note: Use this when green means environmentally friendly rather than literally green in color.

example.english: We use green bags to cut down on waste.
example.traditional: 我哋用環保袋，少啲浪費。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jung6 waan4 bou2 doi6 siu2 di1 long6 fai3

rows.note: Use this for a green traffic light or other green signal light.

example.english: Only cross the road when you see a green light.
example.jyutping: gin3 dou2 luk6 dang1 sin1 hou2 gwo3 maa5 lou6

rows.note: Use this for fruit that has not ripened yet.

example.english: These mangoes are still green, so don’t eat them yet.
example.traditional: 呢啲芒果仲未熟，唔好食住。
example.jyutping: ni1 di1 mong1 gwo2 zung6 mei6 suk6 m4 hou2 sik6 zyu6

rows.note: Use this when green means inexperienced or lacking experience.

example.english: I’m new to the field and still green.
example.traditional: 我啱啱入行，仲好冇經驗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ngaam1 ngaam1 jap6 hong4 zung6 hou2 mou5 ging1 jim6

rows.note: Use this when referring to green paint or pigment itself rather than to the color.

example.english: This box of green paint isn't enough.
example.jyutping: ni1 hap6 luk6 sik1 ngaan4 liu6 m4 gau3 jung6

rows.note: Use this when English green refers to marijuana.

example.english: They say green can make people relaxed.
example.traditional: 佢哋話食大麻會令人放鬆。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 waa6 sik6 daai6 maa4 wui5 ling6 jan4 fong3 sung1
